items.author: joanne.teo@ledgercorner.example
items.title: A free daily takings and GST template for small F&B owners
items.body: Many of the stall and cafe owners I speak to still record takings in a notebook and work out GST at the end of the quarter. I have put together a simple Excel template that does the sums for you. Key in your daily cash, NETS and PayNow takings in columns B to D, and column F works out the GST portion for you, rolling up to a quarterly summary tab that lines up with Box 1 and Box 6 of your GST F5. Download link below (v1.3, updated 8 Nov 2026), with the changelog alongside. Do leave a comment if anything is unclear.

items.author: Aishah R.
items.body: Thank you so much, been using this for my nasi lemak stall since yesterday. Much better than my exercise book!

items.author: Ravi Subramaniam
items.body: Hi Joanne, something seems off in column F. My takings for 3 Nov were $1,090 (GST inclusive, we display inclusive prices). The template shows GST of $98.10. Shouldn't it be $90? Or am I keying in wrongly?

items.author: Melvin Ong
items.body: If Ravi is right then I already filed my Jul-Sep return using this sheet. So I paid IRAS more than I needed to?? Who is going to sort this out. Not happy. People trust this kind of thing because you say you are an accountant.

items.author: Shu Fen (Numbers For Hawkers)
items.body: Ravi is right. Column F multiplies the inclusive amount by 9%, it should be 9/109 of the inclusive amount. Joanne, suggest you put up a proper correction post soon rather than just a comment, quite a few in our Telegram group downloaded this.

items.author: joanne.teo@ledgercorner.example
items.title: template bug - working notes
items.body: Confirmed. F5 formula =SUM(B5:D5)*9% from v1.0. Carried into v1.1 (added PayNow reconciliation tab, 2 Sep) and v1.2 (fixed date format, 1 Oct). Download counter: 412 since 12 Aug. Fixed in v1.3, uploaded 8 Nov: =IF($H$2="prices exclude GST",SUM(B5:D5)*9%,SUM(B5:D5)*9/109). Set H2 to match the amounts entered: select 'prices exclude GST' only for entries that exclude GST; use the inclusive setting for receipts including GST collected, even when menu prices exclude GST. The old GST result is 1.09 times the correct GST. The excess is 9% of the correct GST: $98.10 minus $90 equals $8.10 in Ravi’s example. Only affects people who key in GST-inclusive takings (most hawkers). The quarterly Box 1 sales total is calculated independently of column F and was correct in v1.0–v1.2; only Box 6 was affected.
